sentences.en: The lawsuit is likely to end in our defeat.
sentences.zh: 这起诉讼很可能以我们的失败告终。

sentences.en: A bad compromise is better than a good lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的妥协总比一场诉讼好。

sentences.en: I would prefer any alternative to a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿选择任何其他方案也不愿打这场官司。

senses.zh: 诉讼（尤指非刑事案件）；诉讼案件
